Yutnori renderer dependencies, vendored because this repository deploys its existing files without an npm install step.

- Three.js 0.185.0: `three.module.min.js`, `three.core.min.js`. Source: https://www.npmjs.com/package/three/v/0.185.0 (MIT, THREE-LICENSE.txt).

Only the administrator's Yutnori page imports these modules. No external CDN requests are required.
